Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds described in document CHEMBL5241111. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return all rows including those without structures. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
